alaun.m: Hello. I'm Alaun. How can I help you?
r: Have you seen my brother Andor? He looks similar to me.
Do you have a job for me?
Gison gave me some of his soup.

alaun_1.m: Oh, how surprising. How nice of you. Indeed there is something you could do for me.

alaun_2.m: You are looking for your brother you say? Looks like you? Hmm.

alaun_3.m: No, I cannot recall seeing anyone by that description. Maybe you should try in Crossglen village west of here.

alaun_4.m: Ahh, you are here to earn some money, okay.

alaun_5.m: I'll give you 10 gold if you do this little job for me: Bring me some of that delicious soup which Gison cooks using mushrooms and wild herbs.
r: Give me 15 and I'll do it.
Give me 20 and I'll do it.
No way, I'm not your gopher.

alaun_bela_soup.m: Ah, my friend! Have you heard the great news? Gison and Nimael have started supplying the tavern here in Fallhaven with their newest soup. It's marvelous!

alaun_complete.m: Ah, my hero returns. Thank you for the soup, it was incredible. What can I help you with today?
r: Have you seen my brother Andor? He looks similar to me.

alaun_fail.m:
You dare show your face in my home again? Out! Now!

[Alaun starts throwing things at you again]

alaun_more1.m:
15? Let me think...erm...

OK, I'll give you 15.
r: Sounds good. I will do it.

alaun_more2.m:
20? Let me think...erm...

OK. I'll give you 20. But please, bring it hot or I won't pay you.
r: Sounds good. I will do it.

alaun_return.m: Aah, you are back. Wonderful. I will stop working for now and take a little break.

alaun_return10.m:
Here is the money I promised you.

And as a bonus I will give you some of this bread.

Next time I will buy Nimael's soup.

alaun_return15.m:
Here is the money I promised you.

Next time I will buy Nimael's soup.

alaun_return20.m:
Here is the money I promised you.

Next time I will buy Nimael's soup.

alaun_return_blindstart.m: Yes. I asked you to bring me some of that delicious mushroom soup from Gison.
r: Can you explain the way again?
I was not able to bring you the soup.

alaun_return_coldsoup.m: This soup is cold. Return to me with a hot soup!

alaun_return_end.m: Thanks again. And remember to take the bottle back to Gison. Now go please. I want to eat.

alaun_return_fail.m:
That can't be. Get out of here!

[Alaun starts throwing things at you]

alaun_return_nimael.m: Yes. Nimael also makes very good soup. Vegetables with forest herbs. If I buy both I hope they will argue less about whose is better.

r: Oops, I forgot that there is a hole in my bag.

alaun_return_nosoup_1.m: What are you waiting for? Go on, bring me some soup. Hurry, I'm hungry!

alaun_startquest_go.m: You can find Gison and his wife Nimael south of here. Cross the path and head into the woods. You will find their house soon.

He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.

gison_soup.24: Gison gave me a new soup for 50 gold.
gison_soup.26: Gison gave me a new soup for 500 gold.
gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.

Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.

gison_soup.40: Gison thanked me for bringing the empty bottle back to him.

I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.
